guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以沼氣污染物分離、甲烷回收與淨能源為主線，從乾基氣量與甲烷分率、水分與冷凝、硫化氫吸附床、矽氧烷與設備沉積進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops biogas contaminant separation, methane recovery and net energy through ten connected units, beginning with dry-gas volume and methane fraction, moisture and condensation, hydrogen-sulfide sorbent bed, siloxanes and equipment deposition. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「乾基氣量與甲烷分率」的觀測點。使用氣體分析器與標準化流量計配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「水分與冷凝」的觀測點。量冷凝水並以露點儀確認乾燥器出口。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「硫化氫吸附床」的觀測點。分別採床前後濃度並以累積負荷比對突破。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「矽氧烷與設備沉積」的觀測點。分別採床前後濃度並以累積負荷比對突破。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「二氧化碳分離」的觀測點。使用氣體分析器與標準化流量計配對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「甲烷滑漏」的觀測點。量產品、尾氣及洩漏的 CH4 質量，閉合收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「儲氣與用氣配對」的觀測點。比對標準化甲烷流量與發電機電表。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「發電熱值基準」的觀測點。比對標準化甲烷流量與發電機電表。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「輔機與淨能源」的觀測點。用分表列出每一輔機與可用餘熱。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「成分及維護交接」的觀測點。比對床前床後同時採樣與氣體分析校正。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for dry-gas volume and methane fraction. Pair gas composition with normalized volumetric flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for moisture and condensation. Measure condensate and check dryer outlet with a dew-point instrument. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for hydrogen-sulfide sorbent bed. Sample before/after the bed and compare breakthrough against cumulative loading. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for siloxanes and equipment deposition. Sample before/after the bed and compare breakthrough against cumulative loading. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for carbon-dioxide separation. Pair gas composition with normalized volumetric flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for methane slip. Measure methane in product, tail gas and leaks to close the balance. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for storage and demand matching. Compare normalized methane flow with the generator meter. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for generation heating-value basis. Compare normalized methane flow with the generator meter. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for auxiliaries and net energy. Submeter each auxiliary and report usable waste heat separately. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for composition and maintenance handoff. Compare simultaneous upstream/downstream samples and gas-analyzer calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 不同標準狀態的流量被直接相加。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。
排出冷凝水就宣稱完全乾燥。診斷與介入：另測露點與含濕，檢查排水及下游相容性。
只依介質名義容量估壽命。診斷與介入：加密床前後取樣與累積負荷圖，確認穿透而非只按日曆。
只量 H2S 就忽略矽氧烷。診斷與介入：加密床前後取樣與累積負荷圖，確認穿透而非只按日曆。
用產品氣純度上升宣稱甲烷產量同幅增加。診斷與介入：以溫壓一致的甲烷組成分析重算，確認乾濕基準。
只公布純度而隱藏尾氣流量。診斷與介入：補測尾氣與溶解甲烷，區分產品純度和回收率。
將日產氣全當同時可供發電。診斷與介入：確認甲烷體積及熱值基準，分開發電、回熱與自用。
效率與熱值採不同基準而虛增收益。診斷與介入：確認甲烷體積及熱值基準，分開發電、回熱與自用。
用毛發電替代可輸出淨電。診斷與介入：核對每個附屬電表與能源邊界，分列熱能和電能。
以一次合格樣本替代長期突破監測。診斷與介入：同步測入口與出口氣體成分，另檢查環境暴露監測。
pitfallsEn: Flows at different reference states are added directly. Diagnostic response: Recalculate from same-condition methane analysis and verify wet/dry basis.
Collected condensate does not prove complete drying. Diagnostic response: Measure dew point/moisture separately and check drainage/downstream compatibility.
Nominal capacity alone overpredicts service life. Diagnostic response: Increase bed inlet/outlet sampling and cumulative-load tracking instead of calendar-only replacement.
Measuring H2S alone misses siloxanes. Diagnostic response: Increase bed inlet/outlet sampling and cumulative-load tracking instead of calendar-only replacement.
Higher product purity is mistaken for equal methane-production growth. Diagnostic response: Recalculate from same-condition methane analysis and verify wet/dry basis.
Purity-only reporting hides tail-gas losses. Diagnostic response: Measure tail-gas/dissolved methane and distinguish purity from recovery.
Daily gas total is treated as instantly available. Diagnostic response: Confirm methane volume/heating-value bases and separate electricity, heat and internal demand.
Mismatched efficiency/heating-value bases inflate benefits. Diagnostic response: Confirm methane volume/heating-value bases and separate electricity, heat and internal demand.
Gross generation is mistaken for net export. Diagnostic response: Check auxiliary meters/energy boundaries and separate heat from electricity.
One passing sample replaces long-term breakthrough monitoring. Diagnostic response: Measure matching inlet/outlet gases and separately check ambient-exposure monitoring.

courses.connection: 本課以沼氣污染物分離、甲烷回收與淨能源為主線，從乾基氣量與甲烷分率、水分與冷凝、硫化氫吸附床、矽氧烷與設備沉積進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops biogas contaminant separation, methane recovery and net energy through ten connected units, beginning with dry-gas volume and methane fraction, moisture and condensation, hydrogen-sulfide sorbent bed, siloxanes and equipment deposition. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
